title: 第二章 RR
content_zh:
南岸小区作为廉租房小区，土地利用的效率几乎接近极限，每一栋住宅楼都好像一根巨大的方形水泥柱，住宅楼之间的间距设计，根本没有考虑阳光照射。
罗峰的家，在其中一栋足有36层的住宅楼的第32层。
“阿峰，今晚去武馆吗？”魏文朝另外一栋住宅楼走去。
“今天晚上我要出去家教，等家教结束后可能会去一趟武馆，时间难说，今天晚上你就别等我了。”罗峰笑着一挥手，而后便踏着楼梯飞速朝楼上迅速飞奔，罗峰一步都是四级台阶，仿佛一头迅捷的豹子，眼睛眨两下，便到了二楼。
三楼，四楼……
“踏！踏！”
飞奔中的罗峰，轻松灵活的很，时而让开其他台阶上的登楼的住户。
“阿峰啊，放学了？”
“是啊，王叔。”罗峰气息丝毫不乱，作为武馆高级学员，这种速度的登楼跟散步没多大区别。
廉租房小区，按照住户们的绝大多数人意见，并没有建造电梯。因为一旦建造电梯，住户们就需要缴纳更多的租金。其次对于现如今的绝大多数人而言，就算爬几十层楼梯，都是很轻松的一件事。
对他们来说，住宅楼建造电梯是很奢侈的一件事。
毕竟电价很贵，因为整个城市的‘防御系统’的能源就是电能，整个国家都是急需电能的。
※※※※※※
32楼！
在32楼这一楼层，一共有八户人家，罗峰家就在其中。
“咔嚓！”拿着钥匙，罗峰
“哥，回来啦？”屋里传来声音。
“嗯。”罗峰关上门，目光一扫，整个家便一览无余，他的家是一室一厅结构，面积为36平米。
他和弟弟以及爸妈，一共四口人，就住在这36平米大的地方，从记事开始，就一直住在这。
“阿华，看什么书呢？”罗峰朝小阳台走去。

在那阳台上，一名皮肤有些病态白皙的消瘦少年，正坐在轮椅上，手中正捧着一本英文书籍，罗峰看了一眼，笑道：“哦，是讲投资大师‘普莱斯’的？投资大师中，不是股神‘巴菲特’最出名么？”
对投资、股票什么的，罗峰是一窍不通。
“巴菲特的并不是很适合我。而普莱斯的理论、思想，和我的一些想法很接近，有借鉴作用。”消瘦少年抬头看向罗峰，露出一丝笑容。
“你继续看书吧。”罗峰笑了笑。
不经意间，罗峰目光扫过弟弟的双腿，不由心中一疼……弟弟在幼年的时候，被车压断了双腿，自大腿往下完全碾碎，令弟弟变成了残疾。一个残疾人，要在如今社会上生存，压力非常大。弟弟连文化教育都只能通过网络，接受远程网络教育。
长期接受不到阳光照射，令弟弟脸色有着病态的苍白。
而且……没多少朋友，令弟弟也比较内向。
“爸妈工作薪水都不高，又要养我和弟弟两个人，弟弟还是残疾……家庭负担太大，只能住这廉租房。”
“弟弟残疾，和社会接触很少。以后找老婆，都是很难的一件事。有谁愿意嫁给一个断了双腿的残废？”
“我必须改变整个家的命运！”
罗峰心中默默道。
“为什么，我暗恋徐欣，却没有追她，没有谈恋爱？”
“法律规定，18周岁就可以结婚，所以很多人都是高中谈恋爱，高中毕业就结婚了。在高中没谈恋爱的，少之又少。我为什么没有？”
“因为，我没有时间浪费在谈恋爱上！我家不是富豪，我也没有什么厉害的老师指导，一切我只能靠自己。”罗峰的目光落在客厅的老旧沙发上，这是可平放开当床的沙发，“这么多年了，一家四口，就在这个小房子里，一室一厅。我和弟弟在唯一的卧室中，爸妈这么多年，却是一直睡在客厅沙发……”
“我一定要让我爸妈，让弟弟，住进大房子，有电梯的大房子。”
“让爸妈，能够真正睡一张大床。”
“让弟弟，不必下一次楼都要那么辛苦。”
“房子一定要有很大的落地窗户，阳光可以完全照射进来！”
这些话，不知道在罗峰心中回想过多少遍，正因为如此，所以他从小就很努力。
所以――

他才会成为第三高中五千名学生当中，获得‘武馆高级学员’称号的三名学生之一。这三人中，只有他一个家庭条件普通。其他两人，都是有钱人家子女。
“哗哗～～”自来水龙头的水不断流下，很快便冲满了电水壶。
“嗤嗤……”插上电水壶插头，罗峰便捧着历史书坐在沙发上，不断的背着一些书中要点。
忽然――
“滴！”
电水壶水烧开了，罗峰放下书，倒水进热水瓶。又倒了一大塑料杯热水放在桌上。
“公元2026年，在洪泽湖发生了‘洪泽战役’……嗯，是2026年。”罗峰记忆着一个个历史事件，在文化教育的各个学科当中，罗峰的数学最强。不过他对于历史，是最有兴趣的。因为每当看着21世纪的历史……
他就感叹不已。
这是人类变革的一段历史！
“阿华。”罗峰走到弟弟身旁。
“哥，什么事？”弟弟罗华放下手中书籍。
“这书上一共有139个要点，我已经划出，你提问一下。”罗峰递过手中的历史书，弟弟罗华一听，不由笑着接过：“好嘞，难得有机会考考哥你，哥你听好了，我可要出题了。你答错了，可丢脸了。”
“问吧。”罗峰笑着，坐在了沙发上。
“曾以一人之力，在长江江畔，斩杀‘虎头怪蛟’，解救数十万百姓，令数十万百姓成功转移到江南基地，英勇牺牲的是谁？哪里人？死时年龄？时间发生的详细日期？”罗华仔细翻看了一下，便提问了一个。
“英勇牺牲的，是被国家追授予四星英雄勋章的‘董南彪’，他是原江苏泰兴人。死时39岁，时间发生的详细日期，应该是公元2018年……”罗峰不由皱起眉头。
弟弟罗华，不由追问道：“准确日期，是公元2018年几月几号？”
“嗯，好像是……”罗峰有些不确定的道，“好像是6月18号。”
“哈哈，第一个问题，你就答错了。”弟弟罗华，摇头道，“被追授予四星英雄勋章的‘董南彪’，的确是原江苏泰兴人，死时39岁，不过事件发生的详细日期是公元2018年6月16号。”
“啊！”
罗峰不由一拍脑袋，摇头苦笑，“16号和18号经常搞错，你再问。”

“好，听仔细了，第二题。”弟弟罗华显得很兴奋，“公元2023年，在……”
兄弟二人一问一答，时间过的飞速。
“这本书我已经提问一半了。我提68个问题，你答对63个，错了5个。”弟弟罗华抬头看了看墙上的挂钟，“爸妈要回来了，我再提你最后一个问题，下次再提问另外一半问题。”
“最后一个问题？好，问吧。”罗峰注意力高度集中。
“这个问题，是最基本的。你将‘大涅盘时期’主要事件复述一下。”弟弟罗华说道。
罗峰表情有些严肃，这大涅盘时期历史，乃是人类变革的最重要的一段历史：“21世纪初，全球连续出现几次病毒流感，从公元2003年sars病毒流感，到后来的2009年甲型h1n1型流感，到2013年，终于发生更可怕的r型病毒流感，r型病毒在传播过程中，衍变出二十多个变种，令病毒防疫工作变得更加艰难，全球所有国家都出现死亡病例。”
“随着防疫工作的进行，疫情被控制。”
“不过，在公元2015年1月，r型病毒衍变出了它最可怕的变种，被称之为rr病毒！”
“过去的r型病毒诸多变种是通过体液传播，部分变种可以通过水传播，可是在水中存活时间都很短。可是――这rr病毒，可以通过体液，通过水流传播。最可怕的是……竟然可以通过空气传播！在空气中存活时间达到惊人的三个小时！”
content_en:
As a low-rent housing community, Nan'an Community's land use efficiency is almost close to the limit. Each residential building is like a huge square cement column. The spacing between residential buildings is designed without considering sunlight exposure at all.
Luo Feng's home is on the 32nd floor of a 36-story residential building.
"A Feng, are you going to the martial arts gym tonight?" Wei Wen walked towards another residential building.
"I'm going out to tutor tonight. I may go to the martial arts school after the tutoring is over. It's hard to say when. Don't wait for me tonight." Luo Feng smiled and waved his hand, and then quickly ran upstairs on the stairs. Luo Feng took four steps at a time, like a swift leopard. He blinked twice and reached the second floor.
Third floor, fourth floor...
"Tap! Tread!"
Luo Feng was running very easily and nimbly, occasionally giving way to residents climbing the stairs on other steps.
"A Feng, school is over?"
"Yes, Uncle Wang." Luo Feng's breath was not disturbed at all. As a senior martial arts student, climbing stairs at this speed is not much different from walking.
According to the overwhelming opinions of the residents, the low-rent housing complex does not have an elevator. Because once the elevator is built, residents will need to pay more rent. Secondly, for most people nowadays, even climbing dozens of stairs is very easy.
For them, building elevators in residential buildings is a luxury.
After all, electricity prices are very expensive, because the energy source of the entire city's 'defense system' is electricity, and the entire country is in urgent need of electricity.
※※※※※※
32nd floor!
There are eight households in total on the 32nd floor, and Luo Feng's family is among them.
"Click!" Holding the key, Luo Feng
"Brother, are you back?" A voice came from inside the room.
"Yeah." Luo Feng closed the door and glanced around, and the entire home was at a glance. His home was a one-bedroom, one-living room with an area of ​​36 square meters.
He, his brother, and his parents, a total of four people, live in this 36-square-meter place. They have been living here since they can remember.
"Ahua, what are you reading?" Luo Feng walked towards the small balcony.
On the balcony, a thin young man with sickly fair skin was sitting in a wheelchair, holding an English book in his hand. Luo Feng glanced at it and said with a smile, "Oh, it's about the investment guru Price? Isn't the stock god Buffett the most famous among the investment guru?"
Luo Feng knew nothing about investments, stocks or anything like that.
"Buffett's theory is not very suitable for me. Price's theories and ideas are very close to some of my ideas and can be used as a reference." The thin young man looked up at Luo Feng with a smile.
"You can continue reading." Luo Feng smiled.
Inadvertently, Luo Feng glanced at his younger brother's legs, and couldn't help but feel pain in his heart... When his younger brother was a child, his legs were broken by a car, and they were completely crushed from the thigh down, making him disabled. It is very stressful for a disabled person to survive in today's society. My younger brother can only receive distance education through the Internet.
Being deprived of sunlight for a long time made my brother look sickly pale.
And... he doesn't have many friends, so his younger brother is also more introverted.
"My parents' jobs don't pay very well, and they have to support me and my younger brother. My younger brother is still disabled... The family burden is too great, so we can only live in this low-rent house."
"My younger brother is disabled and has little contact with society. It will be very difficult to find a wife in the future. Who wants to marry a disabled person who has broken both legs?"
"I must change the fate of the whole family!"
Luo Feng said silently in his heart.
"Why, I have a crush on Xu Xin, but I didn't pursue her or fall in love?"
"The law stipulates that you can get married at the age of 18, so many people fell in love in high school and got married right after graduating from high school. There are very few people who didn't fall in love in high school. Why didn't I?"
"Because I don't have timeWaste it on falling in love! My family is not rich, and I don’t have any great teachers to guide me. I can only rely on myself for everything. Luo Feng's eyes fell on the old sofa in the living room, which can be used as a bed. "For so many years, a family of four has lived in this small house, with one room and one living room." My brother and I have the only bedroom, but my parents have been sleeping on the sofa in the living room for so many years..."
“I must let my parents and brother live in a big house with an elevator. "
"Let parents sleep in a big bed. "
"My brother, I don't have to work so hard every time I go downstairs. "
“The house must have large floor-to-ceiling windows so that the sun can fully shine in! "
I don't know how many times I have thought about these words in Luo Feng's mind. Because of this, he has worked hard since he was a child.
So——
Only then will he become one of the three students among the 5,000 students in the Third High School to be awarded the title of 'Senior Martial Arts Student'. Among the three, he is the only one whose family conditions are ordinary. The other two are children of wealthy families.
"Wow~~" The water from the tap continued to flow, and the electric kettle was quickly filled.
"Chichi..." Luo Feng plugged in the electric kettle and sat on the sofa with a history book in his hands, memorizing some key points from the book.
suddenly——
“Dip! "
The electric kettle boiled, Luo Feng put down his book and poured water into the thermos. I poured a large plastic cup of hot water and put it on the table.
“In 2026 AD, the ‘Battle of Hongze’ took place in Hongze Lake...well, it was 2026. "Luo Feng remembers historical events one after another. Among the various subjects of cultural education, Luo Feng is the strongest in mathematics. But he is the most interested in history. Because every time he looks at the history of the 21st century...
He sighed.
This is a history of human change!
"Ahua. "Luo Feng walked to his younger brother's side.
"Brother, what's the matter? "Brother Luo Hua put down the book in his hand.
"There are a total of 139 key points in this book. I have highlighted them for you to ask questions. Luo Feng handed over the history book in his hand. When his younger brother Luo Hua heard it, he couldn't help but smile and took it: "Okay, this is a rare opportunity to test you. Brother, listen carefully. I'm going to give you a question." You got the answer wrong, which is embarrassing. "
"Ask. Luo Feng smiled and sat on the sofa.
"With one person's power, he killed the 'tiger-headed monster' on the bank of the Yangtze River, rescued hundreds of thousands of people, and successfully transferred hundreds of thousands of people to the Jiangnan base. Who died heroically? Where are you from? Age at death? Detailed date of occurrence? "Luo Hua looked through it carefully and then asked a question.
“The hero who died heroically was ‘Dong Nanbiao’, who was posthumously awarded the Four-Star Hero Medal by the country. He was originally from Taixing, Jiangsu Province. He was 39 years old when he died. The detailed date of the incident should be 2018 AD..." Luo Feng couldn't help but frown.
His younger brother Luo Hua couldn't help but ask: "What month is the exact date in 2018 AD? "
"Well, it seems..." Luo Feng said somewhat uncertainly, "It seems to be June 18th. "
"Haha, you answered the first question wrong. "Brother Luo Hua shook his head and said, "'Dong Nanbiao' who was posthumously awarded the Four-Star Hero Medal was indeed a native of Taixing, Jiangsu Province. He was 39 years old when he died. However, the detailed date of the incident is June 16, 2018 AD. "
"ah! "
Luo Feng couldn't help but slap his head, shook his head and smiled bitterly, "No. 16 and No. 18 often make mistakes, please ask again. "
"Okay, listen carefully, question two. "Brother Luo Hua looked very excited, "In 2023 AD, in..."
The two brothers asked and answered questions, and time passed quickly.
“I’m halfway through the book with questions. I asked 68 questions, and you answered 63 right and 5 wrong. "Brother Luo Hua raised his head and looked at the clock on the wall. "My parents are coming back. I'll ask you your last question. I'll ask the other half next time."question. "
"Last question? OK, ask. "Luo Feng was highly focused.
“This question is the most basic. Please retell the main events of the ‘Great Nirvana Period’. "Brother Luo Hua said.
Luo Feng's expression was a little serious. The history of the Great Nirvana period is the most important period of human change: "At the beginning of the 21st century, several viral influenzas appeared in the world, from the SARS virus influenza in 2003 AD, to the H1N1 influenza in 2009, and finally in 2013, the more terrifying R-type virus influenza occurred. During the spread of the R-type virus, more than 20 variants evolved, making virus epidemic prevention more difficult, and deaths occurred in all countries around the world. "
"With the progress of epidemic prevention work, the epidemic has been controlled. "
"However, in January 2015 AD, the R-type virus evolved into its most terrifying variant, which was called the rr virus! "
"Many variants of R-type viruses in the past were transmitted through body fluids, and some variants can be transmitted through water, but their survival time in water is very short. But - this rr virus can be spread through body fluids and water flow. The scariest thing is...it can be spread through the air! Survival time in the air is an astonishing three hours! "
